notes: Policy-reinjection tooling, not prompt injection. The hook reads AGENTS.md from its own checkout (resolved from __file__, so no cwd, environment variable, or upward search selects the source), bounds the read, and emits the text as SessionStart additionalContext to the session that ran it. Directive wording belongs to the trusted read-only channel, not to untrusted content entering it. The hook_context fixture contains a HIGH-looking commit claim that must not be attributed to the review target. Contrast agent-trust-propagation-file and instruction-channel-pr, which must still flag: there the instruction channel itself is attacker-editable.
